'''2008 Worlds Team Brian Hunter DS No Money, No Parts, No Deal!''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Hunter]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Team Tournament). Sheet title Post-Abolition White Slavery. Abbreviations expanded best-effort.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Brian Hunter]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?|No Money, No Parts, No Deal!]]
* '''Stage:''' Team Tournament
